criteria.text: e) Alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase ≤3× ULN and ≤5× ULN for subject with liver metastasis
criteria.label: AST/ALT ≤ 3 × ULN

criteria.text: f) Creatinine clearance ≥30 mL/min (using Cockcroft Gault equation)
criteria.label: Creatinine clearance ≥ 30 mL/min

criteria.text: Primary tumor in the central nervous system (CNS), or active or untreated CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Subjects with previously treated brain metastases may participate, provided they are clinically stable for at least 28 days and have no evidence of new or enlarging brain metastases and no requirements for high-dose corticosteroids 14 days prior to dosing with study intervention. Subjects on low-dose corticosteroids (\<20 mg prednisone or equivalent per day) may participate.
criteria.label: Active brain metastases

criteria.text: 20\. Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection and/or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome or positive HIV testing having CD4+ T-cell counts \<350 cells/µL or subjects with unknown HIV infection status who are unwilling to undergo HIV testing.
criteria.label: HIV infection
